text: 1. Dasa yime bhikkhave dhammā bhāvitā bahulīkatā ekantanibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya upasamāya abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattanti na aññatra sugatavinayā ti. Katame dasa? 2. Sammādiṭṭhi . . . pe . . . sammāvimutti. Ime kho bhikkhave dasa dhammā bhāvitā bahulīkatā ekantanibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya upasamāya abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattanti na aññatra sugatavinayā ti. [page 240] 240 Aṅguttara-Nikāya. CXXXII. 1-CXXXIV. 3 CXXXII.
